sn22.44:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the way leading to the origination of identity and the way leading to the cessation of identity.
sn22.44:1.4: “And what, bhikkhus, is the way leading to the origination of identity?
sn22.44:1.10: consciousness as self … or self as in consciousness.
sn22.44:1.11: This, bhikkhus, is called the way leading to the origination of identity. When it is said, ‘The way leading to the origination of identity,’ the meaning here is this:
sn22.44:1.12: a way of regarding things that leads to the origination of suffering.
sn22.44:2.1: “And what, bhikkhus, is the way leading to the cessation of identity?
sn22.44:2.2: Here, bhikkhus, the instructed noble disciple …
sn22.44:2.3: does not regard form as self …
sn22.44:2.7: nor consciousness as self … nor self as in consciousness.
sn22.44:2.8: This, bhikkhus, is called the way leading to the cessation of identity.
sn22.44:2.9: When it is said, ‘The way leading to the cessation of identity,’ the meaning here is this: a way of regarding things that leads to the cessation of suffering.”
